eligibleRules.@typescript-eslint/await-thenable: Removing the JavaScript's await changes when the following code runs.
eligibleRules.@typescript-eslint/no-array-constructor: The fix replaces the JavaScript's Array constructor call.
eligibleRules.@typescript-eslint/no-array-delete: The fix replaces the JavaScript's delete on an array element.
eligibleRules.@typescript-eslint/no-base-to-string: The fix changes how the JavaScript stringifies a value.
eligibleRules.@typescript-eslint/no-dynamic-delete: The fix replaces the JavaScript's delete obj[key].
eligibleRules.@typescript-eslint/no-empty-function: Filling or removing the JavaScript's empty function changes the emitted code (a comment does not satisfy this rule).
eligibleRules.@typescript-eslint/no-extraneous-class: The fix removes or restructures the JavaScript's class.
eligibleRules.@typescript-eslint/no-floating-promises: The fix adds void, await or .catch() that the JavaScript does not have.
eligibleRules.@typescript-eslint/no-for-in-array: The fix replaces the JavaScript's for-in loop.
eligibleRules.@typescript-eslint/no-implied-eval: The fix replaces the JavaScript's string-evaluating call.
eligibleRules.@typescript-eslint/no-meaningless-void-o: Removing the JavaScript's void operator changes the emitted code.
eligibleRules.@typescript-eslint/no-misused-promises: The fix wraps or restructures the JavaScript's own callback or condition.
eligibleRules.@typescript-eslint/no-misused-spread: The fix changes what the JavaScript spreads.
eligibleRules.@typescript-eslint/no-require-imports: Replacing the JavaScript's require() call changes the emitted code.
eligibleRules.@typescript-eslint/no-this-alias: Removing the JavaScript's this alias changes the emitted code.
eligibleRules.@typescript-eslint/no-unnecessary-boolea: Removing the JavaScript's comparison with a boolean literal changes the emitted code.
eligibleRules.@typescript-eslint/no-unnecessary-templa: Rewriting the JavaScript's template literal changes the emitted code.
eligibleRules.@typescript-eslint/no-unnecessary-type-c: Removing the JavaScript's own String()/Number()/Boolean()/!! conversion changes the emitted code.
eligibleRules.@typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-unary-minus: The fix converts the operand the JavaScript negates as it is.
eligibleRules.@typescript-eslint/no-unused-expressions: Removing the JavaScript's own expression statement changes the emitted code.
eligibleRules.@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars: Removing the JavaScript's own unused binding or parameter changes the emitted code (for parameters, also Function.length).
eligibleRules.@typescript-eslint/no-useless-constructo: Removing the JavaScript's constructor changes the emitted code.
eligibleRules.@typescript-eslint/only-throw-error: The fix wraps a value the JavaScript throws as it is.
eligibleRules.@typescript-eslint/prefer-promise-reject: The fix wraps a value the JavaScript rejects with as it is.
eligibleRules.@typescript-eslint/restrict-plus-operand: The fix converts an operand the JavaScript adds as it is.
eligibleRules.@typescript-eslint/return-await: Adding or removing await in the JavaScript's return changes timing and error handling.
eligibleRules.@typescript-eslint/unbound-method: The fix binds or wraps a method the JavaScript passes or destructures unbound (only where no typing of the value as a property removes it).
eligibleRules.no-async-promise-executor: The fix restructures the JavaScript's promise executor.
eligibleRules.no-case-declarations: The fix adds a block around the JavaScript's case clause.
eligibleRules.no-cond-assign: The fix restructures the JavaScript's condition.
eligibleRules.no-control-regex: The fix changes the JavaScript's regular expression text.
eligibleRules.no-empty-pattern: The fix changes the JavaScript's destructuring pattern.
eligibleRules.no-misleading-character-class: The fix changes the JavaScript's regular expression text.
eligibleRules.no-prototype-builtins: The fix replaces the JavaScript's obj.hasOwnProperty() call.
eligibleRules.no-regex-spaces: The fix changes the JavaScript's regular expression text.
eligibleRules.no-self-assign: Removing the JavaScript's self-assignment changes the emitted code.
eligibleRules.no-unsafe-finally: The fix restructures the JavaScript's finally block.
eligibleRules.no-unsafe-optional-chaining: The fix restructures the JavaScript's optional chain.
eligibleRules.no-unused-private-class-members: Removing the JavaScript's private member changes the emitted code.
eligibleRules.no-useless-backreference: The fix changes the JavaScript's regular expression text.
eligibleRules.no-useless-catch: Removing the JavaScript's catch clause changes the emitted code.
eligibleRules.no-useless-escape: Removing an escape changes the literal text the JavaScript emits.
eligibleRules.no-var: var -> let/const changes scoping and the emitted code.
eligibleRules.prefer-const: let -> const changes the emitted code.
eligibleRules.prefer-rest-params: Replacing the JavaScript's arguments use changes the emitted code.
eligibleRules.prefer-spread: Replacing the JavaScript's .apply() call changes the emitted code.
